import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get column names for toxicity types
label_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Extract features and labels
X_train = train["comment_text"].values
y_train_labels = {col: train[col].values for col in label_cols}

# Split each label independently for stratification to ensure balanced training sets per class
X_train_full, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    y_train_labels[label_cols[0]],
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_labels[label_cols[0]],
)

# Create the same split for remaining labels (align with the first split)
for col in label_cols[1:]:
    y_train[col] = train[col].iloc[y_train.index.values]
    y_val[col] = train[col].iloc[y_val.index.values]

print(f"Train samples: {len(X_train)}, Val samples: {len(X_val)}")

# Initialize vectorizer
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 3))

# Train vectorizer on full training set
vectorizer.fit(X_train_full)

# Train individual classifiers for each toxicity type
all_models = {}
for i, col in enumerate(label_cols):
    X_train_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_train_full).toarray()
    X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)

    # Use stratification-aware split based on the specific column
    # Since we already split, just use the labeled y_train values
    model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs")
    model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train[col])
    all_models[i] = model

# Evaluate on validation set
scores = []
predictions_all = []
for i in range(6):
    X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val).toarray()
    preds = all_models[i].predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
    predictions_all.append(preds)

    score = roc_auc_score(y_val[label_cols[i]], preds)
    scores.append(score)
    print(f"{label_cols[i]} Validation ROC-AUC: {score:.6f}")

mean_roc_auc = np.mean(scores)
print(f"Validation Mean ROC-AUC: {mean_roc_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_ids = test["id"]
test_vectorized = {
    f"class_{i}": vectorizer.transform(test["comment_text"]) for i in range(6)
}
final_preds = [
    all_models[i].predict_proba(vectorizer.transform(test["comment_text"]).toarray())[
        :, 1
    ]
    for i in range(6)
]
predictions_df = pd.DataFrame(final_preds).T
predictions_df.columns = label_cols

# Save submission in correct directory and format
submission = predictions_df.reset_index(drop=True)
submission.insert(0, "id", test_ids)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print("Mean ROC-AUC Metric:", mean_roc_auc)
